sampling_notes: 33 reviewed unique artifacts, including ten independent photographer contributions sharing a PDF URL. Raw URL-based automated audit undercounts these as one container; manual disambiguation and exact page/creator identities are retained. Six actual repeated photo-series views excluded. Photography-heavy, no measured motion.

deduplication_review.explanation: The helper strips URL fragments and merges ten independently credited contributions because they share one PDF container URL. Manual review of every complete contribution resolves these nine false-positive URL collisions. Each contribution contains three photographs, conservatively counted as one artifact; no claim that 30 photographs are 30 events. Retain the raw automated audit for comparison. Six actual photo-series duplicate views remain excluded.

shared_documents.permission: Publisher explicitly permits personal PDF download, contributors retain copyright; no redistribution.
